purpose: Make every material loss or change of forward execution a first-class, observable state transition that is checkpointed, disclosed to the operator, recovered when possible, durably published to repository-native evidence when applicable, and externally detectable when the acting agent cannot report for itself.
theorem: A workflow cannot guarantee the absence of unexplained stops unless every material non-normal execution transition is observable, classifiable, checkpointed, publicly reportable, recoverable or explicitly terminal, durably attributable, and externally supervised when the acting process can terminate before self-reporting.
core_invariants: Silence is never a valid terminal state.
Recovery does not cancel the obligation to disclose the boundary that materially changed the viable execution path.
An event may remain internal only while it is provably non-material: it does not change viable path, proof state, mutation certainty, scope disposition, authority, or terminal possibility.
If disclosure of raw operational detail is unsafe or private, redact the detail but still publish the existence, impact, proven checkpoint, recovery disposition, and next action.

A material boundary is an opportunity for immediate primary-task recovery and, when repository-relevant or systemic, for durable harness improvement; system improvement must not replace the user's primary outcome.
No agent-local prompt can guarantee reporting after hard termination; an out-of-process supervisor must synthesize a terminal boundary event from the last durable checkpoint.
No completion claim may bypass the finalization gate or promote weaker evidence into a stronger execution state.

public_when_any: proof state changes or a required proof becomes unavailable
mutation side effects are confirmed, partially possible, or uncertain
owned scope, authority, safety, or external-gate disposition changes
the run may otherwise terminate, quiesce, hand off, or silently reduce scope
a retry/fallback changes the mechanism whose success the operator would reasonably interpret as part of the run
the same class of defect recurs or exposes a missing systemic prevention owner
may_remain_internal_only_when_all: no user-visible outcome, path, proof, mutation, authority, scope, or terminal interpretation changes
the retry is bounded and does not alter the claimed proof surface
the event is not a recurrence trigger or evidence of a missing harness invariant

transition_invariants: OBJECTIVE_ACTIVE may reach COMPLETE only through FINALIZING.
A material BOUNDARY_OBSERVED must reach CHECKPOINTED before any retry that could duplicate or overwrite side effects.
A material BOUNDARY_OBSERVED must reach PUBLIC_TRANSITION_EMITTED before ordinary agent-controlled termination.
RECOVERING must resolve to OBJECTIVE_ACTIVE_RESUMED, QUIESCENT_BLOCKED, another BOUNDARY_OBSERVED, or FINALIZING; it may not disappear.
HARD_TERMINATED_SYNTHETIC is emitted only by a supervisor outside the failed acting process.
A recovered boundary remains part of the run history; successful recovery does not erase it.

boundary_event_envelope.raw_detail_policy: Raw provider/tool/runtime messages may be stored only when repository/privacy policy allows. Public reporting must use the smallest safe detail sufficient to identify the boundary and its operational consequence.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Bind mission, owned scope, acceptance criteria, authority, proof ceiling, and current execution state before mutation.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: The agent cannot silently redefine success after encountering friction.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Capture tool/provider/runtime/validator/model-control/user-interrupt events plus semantic cessation where no exception was raised but required progress stopped.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Only explicit exceptions becoming visible while agent-chosen abandonment remains invisible.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Normalize captured events into the canonical boundary taxonomy and typed execution impact.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Repository-specific anecdotes replacing reusable system classes.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Record checkpoint, attempted operation, confirmed/possible side effects, proof obtained, uncertainty, and recovery attempts.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Retries that duplicate mutations or invent state after partial execution.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Emit a compact operator-visible transition whenever materiality is met.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Operationally meaningful information remaining private until the operator notices a stall.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Map the canonical class plus current evidence to an authorized continuation, fallback, serialization, retry, quiescence, handoff, or terminal disposition.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: The agent improvising whether friction means retry, downgrade, ask, or quit.

architecture_layers.responsibility: When a repository is relevant and writable, publish material/systemic boundary evidence into repository-native contract, ledger, issue, receipt, fixture, test, or plan surfaces without creating a second authority.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Useful incident knowledge dying in chat or being copied into ad-hoc files.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Route novel or recurring defects into the existing recurring-defect loop: repair instance, classify family, strengthen canonical owner, add negative fixture and positive control, validate, integrate, retain.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Repeated one-off repairs with no retained prevention.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Reconstruct the requested outcome and require every material item to have a proven, executable, blocked, unsafe, out-of-scope, or successor disposition before terminal closeout.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: Partial completion, first green, or reduced scope being mislabeled COMPLETE.

architecture_layers.responsibility: Observe objective start/checkpoints/terminal events outside the acting process; when the process disappears without a valid terminal transition, synthesize HARD_TERMINATED_SYNTHETIC and expose the last proven checkpoint plus resumable continuation.
architecture_layers.failure_prevented: The impossible self-report case where the agent is terminated before it can disclose its own boundary.

rules: Publish immediately after checkpointing a material event; do not wait for the operator to ask why progress stopped.
If recovery is already underway, say so; recovery is not a reason to suppress the boundary.
Do not expose secrets, private raw payloads, hidden policy text, or unnecessary provider internals; report the safe operational abstraction.
Do not convert a boundary update into plan-only stopping when safe progress-bearing recovery remains.

publish_when: the event changes repository execution, validation, integration, or proof semantics
the event is systemic, recurring, or a novel missing invariant
the event creates required successor work or changes a durable plan
the event must be retained to prevent duplicate mutation or false completion
reuse_order: existing repository work ledger / incident / receipt surface
existing active owned PR or tracked plan
smallest new repository-native artifact only when no suitable owner exists
forbidden: dumping private conversation or secret-bearing raw tool output into a public repository
creating a second authority when a canonical owner exists
publishing bookkeeping-only churn for repeated unchanged blockers
allowing repository publication to replace recovery of the user's primary task

phase_dependencies.phase_1: This contract and human-readable architecture spec define enforcement topology and invariants.
phase_dependencies.phase_2: Define canonical boundary taxonomy and recovery-disposition vocabulary without weakening this architecture.
phase_dependencies.phase_3: Implement negative and positive test floor across capture, disclosure, recovery, persistence, finalization, and supervisor-synthetic cases.
phase_dependencies.phase_4: Strengthen the canonical shared prompt policy plus P07/P13/P94 composition and generated Prompt Kit surfaces.
phase_dependencies.phase_5: Prove repository/provider integration and retain regression coverage.

proof_ceiling: This architecture specifies repository-enforceable state, publication, recovery, persistence, and supervision contracts. It does not yet define the canonical boundary taxonomy, execute downstream runtime supervision, prove model obedience, or prove every Prompt Kit representation has inherited the contract; those are explicit successor phases.
